# Hugh Carrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Almost fourteen at the start of volume 1  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c38 P49](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0049)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c7 P8](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0008)</sub>
- **Titles:** President of the Brierley Village Improvement Society  <sub>[v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Hughie  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c17 P38](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0038)</sub>

## Appearance

Hugh is a tall youth with broad shoulders, wavy chestnut hair, and mischievous light-brown or hazel eyes. He has a distinct chin and a mouth that frequently contorts into a mocking or playful grin. As he matures into a young man, he is described as remarkably handsome, tall, and open-faced.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c28 P32](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0032), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_

## Personality

Hugh is playful, mischievous, and fond of teasing girls, though he also possesses a strong sense of sportsmanship and chivalry. He is ambitious, hardworking, and competitive, driven by high personal principles and clear future goals. He exhibits a generous and self-denying nature, willing to step aside or assist others without seeking praise. Intelligent and independent, he retains an optimistic and pleasant disposition in his interactions.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v1 c37 P40](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0040), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v1 c38 P52](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0052), [v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051)_

## History

After spending three years in Alberta due to his father's ill health, Hugh returned to Brierley school, where he established himself as a leading student. He began a intense academic rivalry with Nell Harcourt after accidentally sparking a long feud by pulling her braid and teasing her about her red hair. Upon completing the Regent's class, Hugh won the prestigious medal at the Academy. He subsequently accepted a teaching position in Pale Sands to earn money for his future medical studies at college. When he discovered that Nell wished to stay in Brierley to care for Thirza, he selflessly withdrew his application for the local school so she could take it instead. Following this gesture, he and Nell reconciled, ending their long-standing feud to become close friends and partners in establishing the Brierley Village Improvement Society. Hugh later stepped down from teaching to attend college at Wexcombe alongside Nell.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c15 P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024), [v1 c36 P3](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0003), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v1 c38 P50](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0050), [v1 c38 P52](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0052), [v1 c38 P55](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0055), [v2 c1 P55](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0055), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 c7 P8](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0008), [v2 c7 P13](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0013), [v2 c25 P70](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0070), [v2 c26 P8](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0008)_
